entities.name: Medge
entities.description: A traditionalist merfolk clutch tender of the Simic Combine who trains protector students, and is accidentally mutated with tentacles by a cytoplast in a zonot.

entities.name: Kaszira
entities.description: A moping, observant student and niece of Speaker Zegana who discovers empathy and a calling to study in the zonots.

entities.name: Miko
entities.description: A brave but unobservant student who plays pranks and nearly touches the cytoplast.

entities.name: Chessa
entities.description: Medge's star pupil, who lacks courage until she tricks the ghost into a krasis.

entities.name: Ptero Zallik
entities.description: A senior clutch tender with a crab torso and pincers who is Medge's rival and an Adaptationist.

entities.name: Andrik
entities.description: A ghost pirate of the sunken Heckless who pretends to be a drowned Orzhov sailor and is bound to a contractual signet carrying stolen Simic treasure.

entities.name: Zegana
entities.description: The Utopian Speaker of the Simic Combine and Kaszira's aunt, who bans Kaszira from the zonots, then accepts her studies.

entities.name: Momir Vig
entities.description: A Simic figure whose keyrune and cytoplast are displayed in the zonot museum.

entities.name: Vannifar
entities.description: A Simic leader who ordered the Guardian Project's reinforcements.

entities.name: Grandfather Karlov
entities.description: A figure the ghost cites falsely as the author of the Divine Contract of Orzhova.

entities.name: Dimas, Laszlo, Saganderis, Fania, Zyanek
entities.description: Other students in Medge's clutch.

entities.name: Simic Combine
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of biomancers and merfolk, split between Utopian and Adaptationist views.

entities.name: Adaptationists
entities.description: Simic merfolk who use bioengineering and Upwelling principles, attracting parents away from traditional tenders.

entities.name: Guardian Project
entities.description: A Simic force using frog mutant guards that takes eighteen protectorate spots.

entities.name: Krasis
entities.description: Escaped, vicious Simic experiments that prey on resplendent benthids and threaten merfolk waters.

entities.name: Resplendent Benthid
entities.description: A large amphibious sea leviathan killed by krasis.

entities.name: Cytoplast
entities.description: An amorphous living genetic manipulator, the last created by Momir Vig, which mutates Medge.

entities.name: Zonots
entities.description: Huge sinkhole habitats leading down to Ravnica's oceans, each a distinct Simic culture with a speaker.

entities.name: Heckless
entities.description: The sunken ship of the ghost Andrik, carrying stolen Simic treasure.

entities.name: Momir Vig's Keyrune
entities.description: A Simic keyrune stolen a century ago, among the treasure aboard the wreck, then displayed in the museum.

entities.name: Contractual Signet
entities.description: A golden medallion marked with an eight-legged starfish that bound the ghost to the ship; Chessa feeds it to a krasis.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city plane where the story takes place.

events.summary: Medge shows her students a motionless elder monk, and Kaszira calculates how long he has meditated from the plankton on him.
events.quote: Seven weeks. That's how long the elder monk has been meditating.

events.summary: Ptero Zallik shows off his crustacean mutation and tells Medge that Guardian Project reinforcements have cut the open protectorate spots to sixty-two.
events.quote: The Guardian Project has decided to send in some reinforcements. They're taking eighteen spots.

events.summary: Medge takes her eight students beyond the safe waters to watch a krasis in action, where they witness a krasis kill a resplendent benthid.
events.quote: A stinger erupts from the tip of the krasis's tail and strikes a killing blow on the beast's soft underbelly.

events.summary: A voice rasping 'passage' draws Medge, Kaszira and Miko into a wreck, where they find a ghost.
events.quote: The human locks eyes with Miko.

events.summary: The ghost Andrik introduces himself as a sailor who fell through a zonot and asks to be taken home with his crew's bodies.
events.quote: I am seaman Andrik, most unfortunate sole survivor of the Heckless

events.summary: Medge agrees to help the ghost reach the surface, and the students lighten and refloat the ship with a benthid vocal sac for buoyancy.
events.quote: We spend nearly an hour and a half of constant blowing, but the ship starts to shift in the ocean bed.

events.summary: The students sail the wreck toward Zonot Five using concealment spells and hide it from a passing krasis.
events.quote: The old wreck fades into a rippling blue haze, like the water itself.

events.summary: At the zonot, Andrik panics, reveals himself as a pirate in opulent robes and unleashes a storm, and the trunk's contents prove to be stolen Simic treasure.
events.quote: You stole these," I say. "Your crew wasn't pontificating! You were pirating!

events.summary: Chessa and Kaszira rip up the medallion binding the ghost, and Chessa lures a krasis into swallowing it, dragging the ghost into the beast.
events.quote: Let's see how you like your new master,

events.summary: The class brings the Simic artifacts to the guardians, who recognize Momir Vig's stolen keyrune, and the museum puts it on display.
events.quote: this is Momir Vig's keyrune. Stolen nearly a century ago.

events.summary: Kaszira decides to study in the zonots to find ways to help creatures survive krasis; Medge praises her.
events.quote: You will make the Combine proud. You already make me proud.

events.summary: Miko's fin knocks the cytoplast from its pedestal and it mutates Medge, giving her tentacles tipped with eyes.
events.quote: Those things at my tentacle tips, they're eyes.

events.summary: Guardians confront Medge for destroying a priceless artifact and a scuffle sends her and her students to the zonot's brig.
events.quote: my class and I are tossed into the zonot's brig.

events.summary: Speaker Zegana bans Kaszira and her friends from the zonots, but Medge pleads that Kaszira be allowed to study.
events.quote: You and your friends are to return to merfolk territory immediately and are hereby banned from the zonots.

events.summary: At the showing, every student except Miko and Kaszira is placed in the protectorate, and Kaszira appears as a Simic biomancer student.
events.quote: I see her in the audience . . . dressed in Simic biomancer robes.

events.summary: Medge and Ptero reconcile and agree to tend their clutches together next year.
events.quote: Maybe next year we can team up,

relations.quote: Come over, you're missing out on the lesson.
Poor kid hasn't solved a single riddle since he's been under my care
senior clutch tender and bane of my existence
Utopian Speaker Zegana—a younger, more petulant version of our leader

relations.note: Chessa feeds the medallion to a krasis, which drags the ghost to be consumed.
relations.quote: Teeth gnash futilely through the apparition as he disappears inside the krasis

relations.note: The signet is a contractual tether binding him to the boat.
relations.quote: It's bound to the boat, so he is, too.
